skills.skill: I can solve simultaneous equations by adding or subtracting them.

items.q: Consider the two equations: $2x - y + 3 = 0$ [1] and $4x - y + 5 = 0$ [2]. If equation [2] is subtracted from equation [1], the resulting equation will be:

items.q:

$\begin{aligned}4x + 3y = 5\\-4x - 5y = -3\end{aligned}$
